notes.title: Breach of Contract Reloaded - Huge Update V1.5
notes.notes:
Dear BOCR players,

We've been working heavily on the game these last few months. With a ton of new progress and work to show off to the crew!
The graphics have been totally beefed up.You'll really see the graphical improvements with this new update.
[b]New[/b] Vs. [b]Old [/b] 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32214450/2a2deba2bf86cc87e0becbb9b22cfec04434d308.png[/img]


[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32214450/0c1ee37f93251122f1abb5c0227506d98c1d53df.png[/img]


Version 1.5 Changelog listed 

- New map Deserted added
- Bomb Defuse game mode introduced
- Team balancing and player capping on certain game modes for game balancing
- Major graphical update to improve visuals of the game
- Lighting improvements on all maps
- Updated UI
- New Main Menu
- Gamepad support for xbox one controller
- HUD changes/improvements
- New character for marines team
- Hitmarkers are now implemented
- Improvements to Flashbangs/Smoke Grenades
- Soldier Animation Bug Fixes
- New Launch Screen
- Map Changes to Enhance and balance gameplay
- Players will now be kicked for inactivity 
- Improved ADS (Aim Down Sights)
- New healing system added. You must now use a syringe to regenerate health
- Main menu music added
- Spawn flipping implemented to reduce spawn trapping
- Sprint animation bug has been fixed
- Heavy breathing and red screen added while damaged heavily
- Flashlight implemented, utilized with the 'Use' key
- New bomb equipment added to bomb defuse for both teams
- Server region selection

notes.title: Small Patch
notes.notes: This patch fixed the problem where the game would lag really badly after a kill or ect... it also fixed a few other things. The lag was a huge complaint by the players so it should be fixed now, if you have any problems please report them on our discord!

notes.title: Big Changes on the Way
notes.notes:
Hi,
Aidan here, the lead developer for Breach of Contract Reloaded.

First of all, I just want to say thank you everyone that gave my game a try.
That means so much to me and words cannot express that. Expect a new soldier coming to you for the Mercs team. Along with new weapons and a new map!
Be prepared, it’s coming.
I want to explain that I am the ONLY developer for this project. So please don't expect me to be able to fix all issues in a quick amount of time. I plan on continuing to update the game on a regular basis. Just understand that in my current situation, I can't do it all. Take a look at the new content coming to the game.
